title: Recover registered repository identity after candidate restart
userIntent: Register an evaluator-owned secondary repository, restart the candidate MCP process, then resolve the same repository by its captured public identity.

intendedBehavior: Repository registration survives a candidate process restart in the same isolated Controller Home.
behavioralInvariants: The recovered repository is the evaluator-owned secondary local Git repository.
regressionRisks: Repository identity is process-local or resolves to the wrong checkout after restart.

provenance.note: Shared restart behavior anchored to the exact v1.7.2 release.
